Hey guys, I've got an itch for a slice of life manga with a more melancholy feel to it. This doesn't mean it can't have humour, and it DEFINITELY doesn't mean something outright depressing (looking at you, Anime Planet, for putting Punpun as melancholy...). Just something that has some wistful moments, nostalgia, a good dose of anything melancholy. Some examples that I've already read would be My Girl, Yugami-kun Doesn't Have Any Friends, and Bones of an Invisible Human. They all have happy moments, perhaps even happy endings, but there's times when they become thoughtful and almost bring you to tears despite not being directly emotional in the same way as a tearjerker or drama would be. I hope that makes it clear what I'm talking about. I generally prefer slice of life stories when they're down to earth and set in the real world, but I'm open to other worlds and a certain level of exaggeration; it's not my go-to though. If it's a relatively popular series (something like MAL's top 200 most popular, give or take), I'm probably already aware of it even if it's not on my list. I'm not opposed to a rec that I've already heard of, but I definitely much prefer more obscure series that I may not even realize exist. Thanks guys!

Are there any anime from the past decade that focus on military operations? If it's older than that I probably know it already. Doesn't have to be the military specific, could be para-military, the police or even a fire-fighting squad. As long as there is a team coordinating with each other to do missions it's fine. But they have to follow orders from a commander. I'm not interested in the politics behind the operation, just the execution with a focus on the whole team including the commander. There needs to be a sense of realism, but it doesn't need to be fully realistic. There are only two anime I remember that have what I am looking for: 2002, Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex 2005, Full Metal Panic: The Second Raid And even these two examples also have a bunch of other stuff mixed in. Other anime that come close (only listing anime I liked and only one per franchise): 2000, Jin-Roh 2003, Gunslinger Girl 2006, Code Geass 2006, Utawarerumono 2007, Darker Than Black 2012, Jormungand 2013, Shingeki no Kyojin 2013, Buki yo Saraba 2013, Log Horizon (the parts where they take down dungeons) 2013, Zettai Karen Children: The Unlimited - Hyoubu Kyousuke 2015, Gate 2017, Youjo Senki
